what: verifier probe 2 -- locus (i) A3 count vs off-path family, at the card's own ladder

gates.note: card: the pointwise argmax runs H,V,H,V

gates.restructured: (R1) run 1 compared at all three eps, which is not a control: only eps = OFF_PATH_EPS = 1e-14 is the shipped family.  Run-1 miss preserved in prereg_run1.

(R2) run 1 asked for 1 at EVERY offset and was REFUTED at +5e-2 and +1e-1.  The gate now covers exactly the offsets the card's own open-set claim ranges over -- MODEL_CARD.md:189 'verified at offsets 10^-9 through 2x10^-2' -- which is the scope of the exploration's headline.  The 5e-2 / 1e-1 reversal, and the flip boundary between +3e-2 and +4e-2, are finding F-relocate.

(R3) run 1 included offset -1e-9, where the dying type's surviving sliver carries alive mass ~4e-10 and the floor is eps*m/J, so the belief is genuinely eps-dependent there.  That row is finding F-eps, not a gate.

gates.note: the exploration's voice-only, no-1/J mass agrees in count with the exact Step-9(b) mass at every eps and every offset -- its two departures from Step 9(b) (m[0] = 0 instead of 2; no 1/J) are inert here because type 0 is alive throughout and 1/J is a rescaling of eps.

blend_uniform (CONTINUOUS, uniform reference) tracks the shipped hard switch; blend_step9b (CONTINUOUS, Step-9(b) reference) tracks switch_step9b.  The REFERENCE MEASURE moves the count; the switch-vs-blend continuity axis does not.

prereg_run1.note: preserved verbatim; the restructure below changes gate FORM and extends the ladder, never a measured number.

findings.claim: Under the Step-9(b) mass-proportional family the A3 failure at this node is RELOCATED along the k_2 ladder, not removed: 1 strict sign change at the card's offsets (1e-9 ... 2e-2) but 3 at the larger offsets where the SHIPPED family gives 1.
findings.consequence: S(k) = empty still holds on an open set of k_2 at (kappa=0.5, tau_50, T=5) under the proof-faithful family.  A3's second clause fails at this node under BOTH families; only the location moves.

findings.claim: The count is eps-invariant at every offset except -1e-9, the one offset at which the dying type is still alive with a sliver mass (~4e-10) comparable to the floor eps*m/J.
findings.consequence: A genuine fixed-t game differs observably from the t = 0 limit only where t*m dominates the vanishing alive mass.  At t = OFF_PATH_EPS = 1e-14 that window is ~1e-16 wide in k_2 -- below the breakpoint-merge tolerance 1e-9 and below double precision at s ~ 1.58.  Evidence for finding F1.
